purpose: Test the team's full event sequencing after S13 falsified simpler BB momentum/rejection. Historical replay measures approve-all candidate quality; AI value is prospective only.

shared.bars: closed 15m signals; 1m global execution; BB20 +/- 2 population sigma frozen on prior bar; ATR14 Wilder
shared.sessions: weekdays, London 02:00-05:00 ET and NY 07:00-11:00 ET; four-hour range frozen at session open
shared.markets: ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, BNBUSDT traded; BTCUSDT context only
shared.portfolio: $250 single global cash/pending/position; $0.50 fixed risk; <=$125 notional; <=$25 margin; <=5x isolated cap; daily stop 0.60%; weekly stop 1.80%; half risk at 4% DD and halt at 6%
shared.ai: Candidate must pass all hard conditions and route quorum. AI may only APPROVE/REJECT and cannot change side, entry, stop, target, size or leverage. Historical run assumes approve-all; provider failure in forward means REJECT.

routes.hard: 3/4 prior bars in causal bottom-20% bandwidth; close beyond frozen prior-four-bar box by 0.10 ATR and beyond prior BB; exact last opposing candle within five bars defines event OB; risk geometry
routes.entry: 50% exact event OB, first resting mitigation, 45m TTL, trade-through required
routes.exit: stop 0.10 ATR beyond distal; actual-fill width 0.35-1.50 ATR; target 2R and >=4x friction; 120m time stop

routes.hard: alt sweeps frozen session boundary and prior BB outer band by 0.05 ATR then reclaims both; BTC has not swept its own session boundary at any prior/current bar; within four later bars close breaks a pivot known before sweep; risk geometry
routes.entry: 50% exact FVG when present, otherwise 50% displacement body; 30m TTL; trade-through required
routes.exit: stop 0.10 ATR beyond event extreme; actual-fill width 0.50-1.80 ATR; nearer of opposite frozen liquidity and 2R, requiring >=1.50R and >=4x friction; 90m time stop

windows.genuine_oos: new data after 2026-09-01 or frozen paper-forward

gates.development: at least 30 fills, positive net PnL and PF >1.05
gates.validation: at least 15 base fills, base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, positive PnL in at least 2/3 symbols and no symbol >60% gross profit
gates.ai_forward: at least 200 resolved candidates and 100 APPROVE; APPROVE PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress; expectancy >=0.10R; 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0; APPROVE beats counterfactual REJECT

costs.semantics: cost-aware deployability cohorts; fewer fills in stress is not robustness

selection: Exactly two central routes, no grid search or rescue mutation. Simultaneous equal-score candidates use ETH, then SOL, then BNB; ineligible execution falls through.
disclosure: All historical months have been inspected in earlier strategy work. Passing retrospective gates would allow paper-forward only, never live deployment. No profit is promised.
